player_prompt.intro: Wena ungumdlali {player_id} kumjikelezo {num_rounds} we-IteratedTwoThirdsAverage. Umjikelezo ngamunye, qagela inombolo ephakathi kuka {min_guess} no {max_guess}. Ngemuva kokuqagela kokubili, inhloso ngu (2/3) x ((isilinganiso sokuqagela kokubili), futhi umdlali onqagela okusondele kakhulu kunhloso uwina lowo mjikelezo. Phendula ngokuqagela kwakho ngefomethi '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomethi engalungile; sicela uthumele ukuqagela kwakho njengo [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ukuqagela kufanele kube phakathi kuka {min_guess} no {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Umdlali 0 wacabanga {guess0}; Umdlali 1 wacabanga {guess1}. Ngakho-ke i-Target ngu: {target}.
